description: Golden parity cases for the CHECKS reads that ask GitHub (#252): fetch_pr_required_check_names and head_commit_has_running_check_runs in lib/github. Each case holds the gh response the shell function reads (null: that gh call fails; for the check runs, one entry a page), the cfwf MCP server result the tool reads (mcp) or its failure (mcpError), for the check runs also the server's tool list (tools, every tool when absent) or its failure (toolsError), what the tool does (required names: answers, fails with exit 1 or refuses with exit 3; check runs: toolStatus), and what the shell function prints (expected, null when it fails) or returns (expected). A tool that fails or refuses leaves the answer to the shell, except a check-run lookup failure, which is exit 2 as the shell's own.
